title: Non-ACM Line Configurations with Minimal Symbolic Initial-Degree Gap
statement: Does there exist a non-ACM configuration of lines $L$ in $\mathbb P^3$ whose ideal $I$ satisfies $\alpha(I^{(2)})-\alpha(I)=1$?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Mini-Workshop: Ideals of Linear Subspaces, Their Symbolic Powers and Waring Problems (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/9, pp. 489--532](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2015/9)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The ACM hypothesis yields a classification for pseudostars and coplanar configurations, but no result was found deciding whether a non-ACM line configuration in P^3 can have the stated alpha difference one.

**Sources checked.**

- [Janssen, fattening of lines in P3](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jpaa.2014.05.033)
- [original OWR report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2015/9)
